_Dive into the fascinating world of evolutionary history, one simulation at a time!_ 

---

###  **What is the Coalescent Explorer?**

The **Coalescent Explorer** is an interactive app that brings **population genetics** to life.  
Simulate **site frequency spectra (SFS)** and **genealogical trees**, and explore how key demographic forces—  
like **population growth**, **bottlenecks**, **migration**, **admixture**, and **population splits**—  
shape patterns of **genetic diversity** across generations.

You’ll gain intuition on how demographic and evolutionary processes leave their signatures in genetic data.

### 🌟 **App Features**

| Feature | Description |
|:--|:--|
| 🎨 **Dynamic SFS visualization** | Watch how demographic changes reshape allele frequency distributions |
| 🌲 **Genealogy simulator** | See how trees stretch or contract with population bottlenecks or expansion |
| ⚖ **Model comparison** | Compare observed SFS with neutral or demographic expectations |
